corrections_resolution.name: corrections_resolution
corrections_resolution.value: "corrections"."status" = 'open' or ("corrections"."resolution" is not null and "corrections"."resolved_at" is not null and "corrections"."resolved_by" is not null)

episodes_hold_reason.name: episodes_hold_reason
episodes_hold_reason.value: "episodes"."state" not in ('blocked','failed','cancelled') or ("episodes"."state_reason" is not null and length(trim("episodes"."state_reason")) > 0)

episodes_held_from.name: episodes_held_from
episodes_held_from.value: "episodes"."state" not in ('blocked','failed','cancelled') or "episodes"."held_from" is not null

jobs_lease.name: jobs_lease
jobs_lease.value: "jobs"."state" <> 'leased' or ("jobs"."lease_owner" is not null and "jobs"."lease_expires_at" is not null)

publish_jobs_reason.name: publish_jobs_reason
publish_jobs_reason.value: "publish_jobs"."state" not in ('failed','cancelled','needs_reconciliation','retry_wait') or "publish_jobs"."state_reason" is not null

publish_jobs_published.name: publish_jobs_published
publish_jobs_published.value: "publish_jobs"."state" <> 'published' or ("publish_jobs"."remote_media_id" is not null and "publish_jobs"."permalink" is not null)
